_comment: Per-target limits for rpi4. Copied to /etc/deputyos/limits.json at bake time. Schema lives in deputyctl/src/limits.rs. See docs/14-limitations.md §'Pi 4 (4 GB)' for the source-of-truth narrative.

limitations.reason: Pi 4 RAM (4 GB) and CPU (Cortex-A72) below local-LLM threshold
limitations.unblock: rpi5 8GB+ or x86_64-mini-pc; or run model via cloud provider

limitations.reason: Cortex-A72 too slow for real-time wake-word detection

limitations.unblock: rpi5 with active cooler, or x86_64-mini-pc

limitations.reason: clamd RSS exceeds Pi 4 RAM headroom; on-demand clamscan timer used instead
WhatsApp Cloud webhook RSS exceeds low-tier RAM headroom
limitations.unblock: upgrade to standard or high RAM tier

limitations.reason: Discord voice gateway RSS + jitter buffer exceed low-tier headroom
limitations.unblock: upgrade to standard or high RAM tier

limitations.reason: SD card I/O thrashes under simultaneous update + backup load
rpi4 CPU can only run LFM2-350M (lean tier) at usable t/s
